ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious User Agent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious malformed user agent strings in proxy logs Note: Unmapped fields: c-useragent, cs-host

sequences.query: ((c-useragent = RGX("^user\\-agent") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozilla\\/3\\\.0\\ ") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozilla\\/2\\\.0\\ ") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozilla\\/1\\\.0\\ ") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozilla\\ ") OR c-useragent = RGX("^\\ Mozilla\\/") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozila\\/") OR c-useragent = RGX("^Mozilla\\/4\\\.0\\ \\(compatible\\;\\ MSIE\\ 6\\\.0\\;\\ MS\\ Web\\ Services\\ Client\\ Protocol")) OR (c-useragent = RGX(".*\\ \\(compatible\\;MSIE\\ .*") OR c-useragent = RGX(".*\\\.0\\;Windows\\ NT\\ .*") OR c-useragent = RGX(".*loader.*")) OR (c-useragent = "\_" OR c-useragent = "CertUtil\ URL\ Agent" OR c-useragent = "Mozilla\/5\.0\ \(Windows\ NT\ 10\.0\;\ Win64\;\ x64\;\ rv\:60\.0\)" OR c-useragent = "Mozilla\/5\.0\ \(Windows\ NT\ 6\.3\;\ WOW64\;\ rv\:28\.0\)\ Gecko\/20100101\ Firefox\/28\.0" OR c-useragent = "HTTPS" OR c-useragent = "Erbium\-UA\-4ce7c27cb4be9d32e333bf032c88235a" OR c-useragent = "x" OR c-useragent = "xxx")) AND  NOT ((c-useragent = "Mozilla\/3\.0\ *\ Acrobat\ *" OR (cs-host = RGX("\\\.acrobat\\\.com$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.adobe\\\.com$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.adobe\\\.io$"))))
